groups.note: Students must take two French and/or Francophone Literature Courses at the 300-/400- level, one of which is focused in the Medieval/Early Modern Period, chosen in consultation with an academic advisor.

groups.label: Electives
groups.note: Three French courses at the 300- or 400-level in any of the following areas: language and translation, business, cinema, culture, linguistics, literature, media, chosen in consultation with an academic advisor.
